title: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
authors: Vishal P. Baloria; Trent J. Krupa; David P. Weber
near_miss_reason: Table 10 (brokerage-closure DiD) uses a staggered binary shock with firm and fiscal-year FE, but every column adds time-varying firm controls (leverage, growth, analyst/guidance/IC measures, segment counts, etc.). The final dataset is not shipped (WRDS-licensed inputs and a closure list available only on request from James Warren), so the paper is excluded from 5c as well.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies (staggered brokerage-closure shock, post_broker_treat, absorb(fyear gvkey1)), but all 8 main-text columns of Table 10 include time-varying controls, and the analysis data are not shipped. Tables 3-9 are association regressions of TFP on the continuous IIA measure with industry and year FE (not DiD).
design_notes: Firm-year Compustat panel 2002-2013 for the brokerage test. Treatment onset coded at closure year + 2 (merge on fyear = yearstop + 2, then fyear >= max(yearstop) + 2). Firms with several closures get post_broker_treat = 1 in each closure year + 2 and from the latest closure year + 2 onward, so the indicator can switch off between closures (would need the 'drop switched-off periods' rule). Never-treated firms present.
estimators_reported: OLS with industry and year FE on continuous IIA (association tests)
main_or_robustness: main (the brokerage DiD is the causal test reported in the abstract; the main association tests use a continuous regressor)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Closure years vary across firms (staggered), but the closure list is not shipped, so the cohort count cannot be computed.

specs.outcome: win_difret (IIA: insider-trading return difference, top vs. divisional managers)
specs.treatment_definition: post_broker_treat = 1 from fiscal year (closure year + 2) onward for firms losing analyst coverage in a brokerage closure (James Warren closure list, closures only); built in 06_CODE_SAS_REPLICATION.sas lines 1772-1813. Closure years vary across firms (4,720 ticker-years for 2,584 tickers in the closure list).
specs.controls: lat ln_age lag_leverage pct_grow_5yr cash_suff_ratio comp_iiq mgt_eps_guide no_ic_weak psi lag_comstk_issue1 num_bsegs num_unrel_seg1 div_vol1 hhi_div1 ($controls_noanaly)
specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (5c candidate only, but data not shipped)
